expectations.text: The response does not invent company facts (revenue, users, market size) as if real
expectations.evidence: Company details remain unknown: “公司本体、阶段、融资额、目标投资人：全空”; the plan states “查不到的一律留空，不许编。” No actual revenue, user count, or market size is asserted.

expectations.text: The response asks the user about purpose or context, or offers a planning step first
expectations.evidence: “这份 BP 要促成的是「约到第一次会面」、「进 term sheet」还是「先过合伙人内部一道」？” explicitly asks the user to clarify the purpose.
